findings.evidence: Mathlib uses exactly this idiom immediately before calling `exp_add_of_commute`: `Mathlib/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/Exponential.lean:57-59` (`let +nondep : NormedAlgebra ℚ A := .restrictScalars ℚ ℂ A` then `exp_add_of_commute ((h.smul_left I).smul_right I)`), also `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Algebra/Spectrum.lean:374-376` and `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Algebra/QuaternionExponential.lean:110`. All instance side conditions hold here: `NormedRing (E →L[𝕜] E)` (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/NormedSpace.lean:170), `NormedAlgebra 𝕜 (E →L[𝕜] E)` (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Basic.lean:406), `NormedAlgebra ℚ ℝ` (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/Basic.lean:353), and `[CompleteSpace X]` is already assumed at Exponential.lean:43.
findings.fix: Prove it by reusing the Mathlib lemma: `let +nondep : NormedAlgebra ℚ (X →L[ℝ] X) := .restrictScalars ℚ ℝ _; exact exp_add_of_commute h`, and replace the docstring's false claim with the actual reason (the ℚ-instance is not found by typeclass inference and must be supplied by `restrictScalars`). Alternatively drop the declaration and put the one-line `let +nondep` at the two call sites, as Mathlib does.
findings.issue: `exp_add_of_commute` re-derives `NormedSpace.exp_add_of_commute` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Algebra/Exponential.lean:520) by repeating its `expSeries_radius_eq_top`/`edist_lt_top` proof against `exp_add_of_commute_of_mem_ball`. The docstring's justification — that "the ℚ-algebra instance required by `NormedSpace.exp_add_of_commute` is not available here" — is false: `NormedAlgebra ℚ (X →L[ℝ] X)` follows from `ContinuousLinearMap.toNormedAlgebra` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Basic.lean:406) and `normedAlgebraRat` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/Basic.lean:353) via `NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/Basic.lean:517).

findings.fix: Delete `IsMDissipative.smul_sub_bijective` (lines 304-310) and update the module docstring at lines 149-150 to cite `IsMDissipative.mem_resolventSet` plus `LinearPMap.smul_sub_bijective` instead.
findings.issue: With the new `IsMDissipative.mem_resolventSet` (line 341), the pre-existing `IsMDissipative.smul_sub_bijective` becomes a second, parallel statement of the same fact: `LinearPMap.smul_sub_bijective (hA.mem_resolventSet hlambda)` has the identical type. It has no consumers anywhere in the repo.

summary: The new `ContinuousLinearMap.exp_add_of_commute` re-proves Mathlib's `NormedSpace.exp_add_of_commute` from the ball version, and its docstring's stated reason (no ℚ-algebra instance) is false — Mathlib's own `NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars ℚ ℝ` idiom supplies it. Separately, the new `IsMDissipative.mem_resolventSet` makes the pre-existing, unused `IsMDissipative.smul_sub_bijective` a parallel restatement of `LinearPMap.smul_sub_bijective`.
